<div style='text-align: justify;'>
# Wave 3

## Sample

Data from Wave 3 in this dashboard is based on the completed questionnaires of **1,293 participants**, of which 1,002 via an online panel and 291 via an address sample (online via letter and paper-and-pencil questionnaire). Data collection took place in **December 2025**.
</div>
